_disclaimer: Every article, title, and query below is author-written for pipeline validation. None of this is official Samsung/SIIS content, and none of it claims to be. articles.title: Battery drains unusually fast on your Galaxy phone
articles.content:
Smartphone,Others Mobile Battery drains unusually fast on your Galaxy phone ( Smartphone,Others Mobile): # Troubleshooting Fast Battery Drain
## Turn On Power Saving
Go to Settings. Tap Battery. Tap the switch next to Power saving to turn it on.
## Enable Adaptive Battery
Go to Settings. Tap Battery. Tap the switch next to Adaptive battery to enable it.
## Put Unused Apps To Sleep
Go to Settings. Tap Battery. Tap Put unused apps to sleep.
## Restart Your Device
Press and hold the Power button, then tap Restart. Tap Restart again to confirm.

articles.title: My phone gets hot while charging or during heavy use
articles.content:
Smartphone,Others Mobile My phone gets hot while charging or during heavy use ( Smartphone,Others Mobile): # Troubleshooting Device Overheating
## Turn Off Fast Charging
Go to Settings. Tap Battery. Tap the switch next to Fast charging to turn it off.
## Diagnose Overheating
Open Samsung Members and run the overheating diagnostic to check your device.
## Avoid Using The Phone While Charging
Avoid using your phone for demanding tasks while it is charging, and let it cool down in a shaded area if it feels hot.

That step is expected to resolve as Manual, not a placeholder or fabricated link. The only reachable target here is Fast charging (DL-0403, offURL).

articles.title: Photos from the camera look blurry on a Galaxy phone
articles.content:
Smartphone,Others Mobile Photos from the camera look blurry on a Galaxy phone ( Smartphone,Others Mobile): # Troubleshooting Blurry Camera Photos
## Clean The Camera Lens
Check the camera lens for smudges, dust, or a scratched or cracked lens cover, and gently clean it with a soft, lint-free cloth.
## Hold The Phone Steady
Hold your phone steady and tap the screen to focus before taking the photo.
## Contact Samsung Support
If your photos are still blurry after cleaning the lens and checking focus, please contact Samsung Support to arrange for service in case the lens itself is damaged.
